GitHub Page
Setup Guide

// Every step with real screenshots from when we did it //

// Phase 1 — Create the Repository

Step 1 — Fill In Repo Details

1
First ScreenFill In & Configure

After clicking "New repository" on GitHub, fill it in exactly like this:

  • Description: Type DuttyBookbag Indicators
  • Visibility: Select Public
  • Toggle Add README to ON
  • Leave .gitignore and License blank
  • Scroll down → tap green Create repository
github.com — New Repository
✅ This is what the config screen looks like — Public + README ON
2
Repo CreatedYour Repo Homepage

After creating, you'll land on your repo homepage. It shows README.md and the repo is live on GitHub.

github.com/duttybookbag/duttybookbag
✅ Repo is created — only README.md shows for now
// Phase 2 — Upload Your Files

Steps 3-5 — Upload index.html & README

3
Upload FilesAdd index.html + README.md

From your repo tap ... → Upload files → select both files from your phone downloads.

  • Tap ... next to the green Code button
  • Tap "Upload files"
  • Select index.html AND README.md
  • Make sure "Commit directly to main branch" is selected
  • Tap green Commit changes
Upload files screen
✅ Both files queued up — tap Commit changes
⚠ If file saves as index-1.html instead of index.html — see Step 4 to rename it
4
If NeededRename index-1.html → index.html

If your file uploaded as index-1.html you must rename it:

  • Tap on index-1.html in the file list
  • Tap the pencil ✏️ edit icon
  • Tap the filename at the top and change it to index.html
  • Scroll down → tap Commit changes
After upload — only README showing (need to re-upload)
⚠ This is what it looks like when index.html didn't upload — try again
🚨 MUST be named exactly index.html — GitHub Pages won't find it otherwise!
5
SuccessBoth Files Showing

When upload works correctly, you'll see both README.md and index.html in the file list.

Both files uploaded successfully
✅ README.md + index.html both showing — perfect!
// Phase 3 — Enable GitHub Pages

Steps 6-9 — Go Live

6
🔑 Critical StepSwitch to Desktop Site

GitHub Pages settings are hidden on mobile. You MUST switch to desktop mode first.

📱 How to Switch to Desktop Site
  • Tap the 3 dots menu ⋮ in your browser top right
  • Tap "Desktop site" or "Request desktop site"
  • Page reloads — now you'll see the full GitHub layout with all tabs
After switching to desktop site — Settings tab now visible
✅ Desktop mode — Settings tab now visible at top
7
Settings MenuFind Pages in Sidebar

Tap Settings tab → scroll down the left sidebar → find Pages under "Code and automation".

Settings sidebar — Pages highlighted
✅ Tap Pages — it's in the left sidebar under Code and automation
8
Pages ScreenSet Branch to Main & Save

On the GitHub Pages screen under Branch — tap the None dropdown → select main → tap Save.

GitHub Pages — Branch set to None
⚠ This is what it looks like BEFORE saving — Branch says None
After saving — Branch set to main ✅
✅ "GitHub Pages source saved" — Branch now set to main
✔ You'll see a green bar at top saying "GitHub Pages source saved" — that means it worked!
9
Site is Live!Get Your Live Link

Wait 1-3 minutes then refresh the Pages settings screen. A box appears at the top with your live URL.

GitHub Pages — Your site is live!
✅ "Your site is live at https://duttybookbag.github.io/duttybookbag/"
⚠ Seeing 404? Just wait 2-3 more minutes and refresh. It's still building.
// Phase 4 — Updating Files Later

How to Replace index.html

10
Delete Old FileRemove Old index.html

When Claude gives you a new index.html, delete the old one first:

  • Go to your repo → tap index.html
  • Scroll right to find ... menu
  • Tap Delete file
  • Tap Commit changes
File deleted — "This file was deleted"
✅ Tap "Commit changes" to confirm deletion
11
Upload New FileAdd the New index.html

After deleting, upload the new file:

  • Tap + button next to Code button
  • Tap Upload files
  • Select new index.html from downloads
  • Tap Commit changes
After uploading new index.html
✅ New index.html uploaded — site auto-updates in 1-2 min
Repo with both files — ready!
✅ Both README.md + index.html showing — deployment shows green ✅
// Quick Reference

Cheat Sheet

  • github.com → sign in → + New repository
  • Name it → Public → README ON → Create
  • ... → Upload files → index.html + README.md → Commit
  • Check file is named index.html not index-1
  • Browser menu → Request Desktop Site ← KEY STEP
  • Settings → Pages → Branch: main → Save
  • Wait 2 min → refresh Pages → get live URL 🔥
  • To update later: tap index.html → ... → Delete → upload new one
